name: bellchain
description: Your Bellchain crypto alert chains and alerts in Claude: ask about them, test ideas in the replay, create and change chains.
long_description: Bellchain is a no-code builder for crypto alerts. With this extension Claude reads your chains and alerts, explains why an alert fired, finds templates, checks prices, tests ideas in the replay and, when you ask for it, creates, changes, activates, pauses and deletes chains. It signs in with your own Bellchain API key (Trader plan), which Claude Desktop keeps in your system keychain. Secret settings of your chains, such as webhook addresses or bot codes, never reach Claude. Bellchain runs no AI of its own and sends nothing to AI providers.

api_key.title: Bellchain API key
api_key.description: Starts with bc_. Create it in Bellchain under Settings → API (Trader plan). “Read only” is enough for questions and replays; “Read and change” lets Claude create, change, activate, pause and delete chains.
